key_insight: A loss-aware CNN decoder turns qubit-loss information into substantially improved error correction, including for a high-rate qLDPC code.
engineering_relevance: Fast loss simulation and neural decoding offer a practical route to evaluating error correction for quantum hardware with detectable qubit loss.
method: Train loss-aware CNN decoders using the new slim sampler for circuits with Pauli noise and qubit loss.
Benchmark surface-code decoding against computationally expensive most-likely error decoders.
Evaluate a walking syndrome-extraction circuit for the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle (Gross) code.
evidence_signal: In simulations, surface-code accuracy matches most-likely error decoding at much lower latency; for the Gross code at physical error rates below 1%, pure loss yields over 1,000× lower logical error rates than pure Pauli noise at the same rate.
watch_item: The largest reported gain compares idealized pure-noise models; hardware benefits will depend on mixed noise and reliable loss-resolving measurements.
paper_title: Neural Network Decoders For Qubit Loss
